page.layout: One printed page: running head and title at top, a woodcut emblem in the centre, a verse of four lines below the woodcut, and a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: ARCVS NIMIS INTENSVS, facile rumpitur.
main_text.p: [woodcut emblem: sky with sun and clouds, a lute resting on a table with an hourglass, books, and coins]

p.i: Sacrosanctarum dulcis symphonia legum est, Omnibus & numeris dulcior Harmonicis: Candida si nostris regnet dilectio rebus, Annuet & summi gratia larga Dei.

page.notes: The woodcut is an emblem picture and is described above, not transcribed. The long s is written as plain s throughout. The running head is the word EMBLEMA in small capitals. The printed ligature in "Sacrosanctarum" and "Annuet" is read as ct and et.
